favorites.page.heading.context: Page heading for the standalone Favorites page. Byte-identical text is also used for the Favorites tab inside the personal-cabinet profile (users.profile.tab_favorites) — same meaning, two different DOM surfaces (a dedicated page vs. a profile tab that mirrors it live, per the source comment at base-layout.html:1320). NOTE: the Favorites feature has very little dedicated UI text of its own beyond this heading — the star-toggle icons carry no separate label, and the 'favorites only' filter checkbox that appears on the News page is cataloged as news.page.favorites_only_toggle rather than duplicated here.
